blocks.text: Mental overwork — new circuit-strain lore, October 26, 2026

These additions extend the existing Cerebral Bufferitis and Rhythmic Charismalgia conditions. Cyberpath's protected-memory, quiet-recovery and resonant-echo themes inform them; the new names are additions, not quotations from earlier stories.
Cache Tangle — Moderate Memory strain. Too many recent patterns compete for the same temporary cache. A quiet recovery interval lets the pet sort its active patterns.
Recall Echo — Severe Memory strain. The overloaded recall circuit repeats traces of earlier patterns. Stored memories and learned abilities remain intact; recovery quiets the echoes.
Rhythm Drift — Moderate Dance strain. A tired internal beat signal loses its steady alignment. The pet benefits from a pause rather than more repeated practice.
Chorus Overload — Severe Dance strain. Competing rhythm echoes overwhelm the signal mixer. Quiet rest and the game's fatigue medicines restore clarity.

Each path has Mild, Moderate and Severe stages within one fatigue condition. Memory/Dance switching preserves the originating identity. Recovery reverses the stages. These fictional temporary conditions are not real diagnoses or permanent disabilities, and they never erase XP or personality. Existing droplets, Stress Tangle and Confused Swirl artwork communicate increasing severity without flashing.
The Gameplay Information tab's October 26 Godot update defines the implemented probabilities, effects and recovery. Earlier historical mechanics elsewhere in this document remain reference material.
